description: React component for managing API keys for different LLM providers, including UI for viewing, editing, masking, testing, and removing keys.

methods.name: toggleKeyVisibility
methods.description: Toggles visibility of API key for security.

methods.name: startEditing
methods.description: Starts editing mode for API key for a provider.

methods.name: cancelEditing
methods.description: Cancels editing mode and resets input fields.

methods.name: saveKey
methods.description: Saves the entered API key for a provider.

methods.name: removeKey
methods.description: Removes the API key for a provider, after user confirmation.

methods.name: maskKey
methods.description: Masks the API key for secure display.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests the API connection with the specified provider.
